title: Fitdays Smart Food Scale with Nutrition Calculator | Calorie Tracking App & High Precision (0.1g/oz) | 11lb/5kg Kitchen Scale for Weight Loss/Meal Prep | White | (KT630-WHITE)
description:
About this item
【Health Management Expert】Download the Fitdays app to track and record food data, calculate calories, offer a detailed nutritional analysis .
【Accurate Measurement】Fitdays Food weight scale can weigh from 1g (0.002lb) to 5kg (11lb) with precision increments of 1g, 1ml, 0.05oz, and 0.1fl.oz, thanks to its four high-precision sensors. It combines the functions of a nutritional scale, kitchen scale, and coffee scale. Additionally, the coffee timer function displays the ratio of coffee beans to water and tracks both the time and weight of the beans.
【Clear Readings Upgrade】Equipped with an LCD, the food scale for weight loss provides a crystal-clear view of the measurements even in low-light environments. The intuitive interface, enhanced by multiple icon prompts, makes it user-friendly for everyone from kitchen beginners to professional chefs. 7.52''x 6.57''x 0.82'' in size, the Fitdays Smart Food Scale comes with an auto-off function to save energy.
【5 Units Option】Easily convert units to ounces(oz), both pounds and ounces(lb: oz), grams(g), milliliters(ml), fluid ounce(fl .oz) for more accurate ingredients. You can switch units both on the calorie scale and phone app. Perfect for Keto, diet, weight loss, or bodybuilding!
【Tare Function】With the one-touch tare function, you will no longer have trouble with complex steps to get net weight! The food weighing scale removes the weight of the container with the tare button, making it easy to get the exact weight of the required items without changing the bowl.
【One Scale for All】The food nutrition scale’s convenient size makes it easy to store, which is travel-friendly and takes up little storage space in a kitchen drawer, cabinet, or travel case. Whether you are measuring ingredients for baking, tracking portion sizes for meal prep, or weighing food for dietary management, this smart food scale with nutritional calculator consistently delivers reliable measurements with every use.
